clean_story:
Now I will teach you Path. Path is the mark left by walking beast or man on soft ground. It is the line where many feet have pressed earth flat. It can be seen as a long scar in grass or dirt, going from one place to another. You follow it to go where others have gone before. It does not move but stays where feet made it. Look for the line in the earth, this is Path.

Discover also track, trail, land.
